section_summary.extract_value: This discussion section examines relationships between body image and subjective happiness in two samples of Western women, finding that body appreciation is a strong positive predictor of happiness while BMI shows a complex relationship. The authors note that 89% of women in their survey experienced weight-based dissatisfaction and discuss limitations including self-selecting samples, online survey methodology, self-reported BMI data, and the cross-sectional nature of the study.
